1.title: Stadium owner Robert Kraft says Ed Sheeran asked him to donate $2m in aid after Macklemore backlash
1.summary: It comes after Macklemore pledged $1m to Palestinian causes, challenging the tycoon to match the sum.

2.title: State Department Extends Visa Ban on Abbas, Other Palestinian Officials
2.summary: The move would prevent Mahmoud Abbas, the leader of two governing Palestinian groups, from traveling to the United States next week for the United Nations General Assembly.

3.title: US blocks Palestinian leader from UN meeting in New York for second year in row
3.summary: The US State Department extended visa sanctions after accusing Palestinian officials of failing to live up to peace process commitments.

4.title: River home to 500 crocodiles chosen as Olympic rowing venue
4.summary: A river that is home to about 500 saltwater crocodiles is given the OK to host Olympic and Paralympic rowing and canoeing events at the 2032 Brisbane Games.

5.title: Carney Calls for E.U.-Canada Pact Amid ‘Ferocious Storm’
5.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney told European lawmakers that an alliance would help to secure sovereignty and independence for his country. The moves come amid a historic low for U.S. ties with Canada.

6.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
6.summary: South Africa police have cautioned against assuming that all the killings are linked but many women are afraid.
